verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 ships with an official NVIDIA developer ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, NGC catalog, build.nvidia.com inference endpoints, an llms.txt developer portal), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official MCP server or endpoint an agent could connect to. Marketing about running agents locally and the llms.txt probe are adjacent features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
